originals.citation: Campbell, C., Tanzer, M., et al. (2021). Development and validation of a self-report measure of epistemic trust. PLoS ONE.

quote: Satisfactory psychometric properties were found to replicate the original three-factor solution in a Francophone population ... Our results regarding childhood trauma replicated those of Campbell et al. [15]
notes: Psychometric replication of the ETMCQ structure and associations from Campbell et al. 2021. Attachment results also compared with Asgarizadeh et al. 2024 (@asgarizadeh2024), which reads as comparison rather than a framed original.
